A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same HAG study. Their main text, equations, tables, figures, and appendices are readable and support reliable matching, including the relocated prompts.

before.justification: v1 reports original comparisons on Bluesky, Amazon Reviews 2023, and IMDb in Table 1, alongside qualitative analyses, an emerging-topic experiment, and human verification.

after.justification: v3 retains those empirical results and adds inference-validation tests, HIT/MISS measurements, and tree-structure experiments in Appendices A.3 and B.3–B.4.

M1.justification: Section 2 and Algorithm 1 retain the same dimension prioritization, conditional-probability tree construction, WVS retrieval, and constrained augmentation. The new structural variants are experimental controls; the proposed procedure is unchanged.

E1.justification: The datasets, selected topics, and Mars Colonization scenario are retained. Appendix A.3 adds a distinct input condition for benchmark extraction: user texts with explicit demographic clues artificially masked.

E2.justification: The four main comparators remain unchanged. v3 Table 7 adds an evaluated Fixed-Dimension Tree comparator, which fixes attributes and their order. This differs from the retained HAG-Flat baseline, which models dimensions independently.

E3.justification: Main benchmark settings and metrics are retained. New targeted protocols mask demographic declarations, sweep tree depths 3, 6, and 9, and compare adaptive selection against a fixed dimension sequence. The original default depth of 5 remains documented.

E4.justification: v3 substantially expands diagnostic coverage beyond the retained HAG-Flat, visualization, case-study, and emerging-topic analyses. It adds masking and repeatability checks, HIT/MISS analysis across four existing topics, and ablations of tree depth and adaptive dimension selection.

E5.justification: Appendix A.3 newly reports three independent inference trials and cross-trial consistency. This is additional repeatability reporting, without evidence of increased runs for the original experiments. The human-verification sampling formula and confidence assumptions are unchanged.

E6.justification: Table 1 and retained plotted results are unchanged, but v3 adds substantial diagnostic findings: 94.3% masking abstention, 95.8% repeatability, HIT ratios of 64.74–68.65%, depth-sensitivity results, and adaptive versus fixed-tree alignment of 0.573 versus 1.205. The new depth-3 alignment score is internally inconsistent: Table 6 gives 1.575, whereas the prose gives 0.875.

T1.justification: The problem definition, conditional probabilities, leaf weights, coverage rule, evaluation formulas, and human-sampling equations are retained. No new theorem, proof, or substantive mathematical derivation is introduced.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the HAG, benchmark, and PACE contributions and the headline 37.7% alignment-error reduction and 18.8% consistency improvement. Additional experiments support these existing claims without redefining their scope.

C2.justification: New interpretations connect excessive depth to sparse retrieval matches and augmentation-driven error propagation, and fixed dimensions to wasted capacity on irrelevant attributes. Appendix A.3 also interprets masking results as evidence-dependent extraction. The original limitations remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v3 newly states that code and data are released and supplies a repository link. Existing embedding-model details, batch sizes, default tree parameters, and substantive prompt instructions are retained. The archetype-judge JSON example also loses an erroneous trailing comma.

R1.justification: The cited works and Section 5 positioning against retrieval-based and LLM-based persona generation remain unchanged. Reference relocation does not introduce a new relationship to prior research.

P1.justification: Most prose and the main section sequence are retained. v3 makes limited language corrections, clarifies the t-SNE description, and reorganizes the prompts from Appendix B.3 into a separate Appendix C.

P2.justification: v3 adds three diagnostic tables and reformats the five retained prompt tables as titled, bordered boxes. It revises Figures 3–4 captions, removes Figure 3 axis tick labels, and adjusts figure sizing and placement. The overall visual structure remains recognizable.

improvement.justification: The new validation and structural diagnostics provide useful support for benchmark reliability and design choices that v1 lacked, while the release link improves reproducibility information. The gains are limited by the conflicting depth-3 score and the unreconciled claim of abstention when the retained extraction prompt instructs choosing a common value if evidence is missing.
